name: standard
description: STANDARD RE-IMAGE (user decision 2026-09-28): what was deployed on <PC-NAME> on 2026-09-28 is how a re-image should look - see docs\standard-reimage.md. Plus the user's 2026-09-28 choices: firewall rules wiped first; update gate LEFT OPEN at the end; Windows Firewall log on (default file, dropped + allowed, 32,767 KB); every general app removed except Camera and Calculator; UAC Always notify; Bing search-box policy; Copilot app removed; permissions = Lock with camera, microphone, radios and location OFF but not locked (location added 2026-09-29). Network services and Devices items are added one at a time after passing the radio test (docs\radio-group-test.md): passed so far = Wi-Fi Direct off + install block (round 1), dial-up/built-in VPN off (round 2), IPsec VPN keying off (round 3), proxy auto-detect Settings switch off with the WinHTTP service untouched (round 4b; disabling the service itself breaks Wi-Fi and is never in the standard), Fax + Phone service off (round 5), SMB 1/2/3 server + client off (round 6), WAN Miniports install block + remove (round 7), Bluetooth network part off: PAN adapter DHCP + autoconfiguration off, adapter disabled (round 8). Dry run first: WHD.ps1 -Apply profiles\standard.json, then add -Execute.
